input.command: for f in config.py settings.py tests/test_routes.py; do echo "## $f (HEAD:)"; git show HEAD:$f; done; echo '## index routes.py'; git show :routes.py; echo '## index preview.py'; git show :preview.py; echo '## ls-files'; git ls-files; echo '## gitignore'; cat .gitignore; echo '## grep'; grep -rn "EXPORT_PREVIEW_ENABLED\|render_preview\|routes" --include=*.py . | grep -v plugins/
input.description: Read committed config, settings, tests and staged files
